channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: T20 WC: Pakistan Govt makes U-turn, allows team to play India match on February 15
item.description: The Pakistan Government has made a U-turn on its earlier stance and has now allowed the men's cricket team to play its scheduled match against India in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup on February 15.

item.title: T20 WC: Klaassen, van der Gugten come in as Netherlands elect to bowl first against Namibia
item.description: After winning the toss, Edwards said left-arm pacer Klaassen and right-armer van der Gugten come in place of Paul van Meekeren and Kyle Klein respectively, thus adding more variety to the Dutch bowling line-up.

item.title: BJP candidate in Telangana municipal polls dies by suicide; family alleges intimidation by opponents
item.description: Erukali Mahadevappa, who had filed his nomination as the BJP candidate from ward number 6 in Maktal municipality, was found hanging at his residence.

item.title: I & CM Siddaramaiah know what we spoke’: DK Shivakumar on Karnataka Congress ‘crisis’
item.description: The "power struggle" within the ruling Congress party in Karnataka appears to be deepening, with Deputy Chief Minister and State Congress President D.K. Shivakumar stating that he and Chief Minister Siddaramaiah are clear about what was discussed in the presence of the party leadership.

item.title: ED arrests two traders in Bengal coal smuggling case
item.description: It is learnt that both the arrested traders will be presented at a special court of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) in Kolkata, and the ED counsel will seek their custody for further questioning.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh CM presents Polavaram-Nallamala Sagar project proposals to Centre
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on Tuesday met Union Minister for Jal Shakti C. R. Patil in New Delhi and presented proposals for the Polavaram–Nallamala Sagar Link Project, aimed at diverting surplus Godavari waters to the drought prone-regions.

item.title: Temperature improves remarkably in J&K as days get warmer
item.description: Temperature improved remarkably across Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday, with Srinagar city recording a minimum temperature of 3.3 degrees Celsius and Jammu city 12.3 degrees Celsius.

item.title: Sonu Sood reacts to Rajpal Yadav’s inability to repay debt: Sometimes life turns unfair!
item.description: Calling Rajpal Yadav a gifted actor who had given years of unforgettable work to the film industry, actor Sonu Sood, who observed that life could sometimes be unfair, has announced that Rajpal Yadav would now be a part of his film.

item.title: ‘Does govt believe Penguin over Naravane?’ Rahul Gandhi’s fresh salvo over memoir row
item.description: He also showed reporters an X post by a former Army chief from 2023, where he urged the people to read memoirs detailing what happened at the Galwan clashes in 2020. “Naravane tweeted in 2023. Just follow the link - happy reading, Jai Hind.

item.title: Uproar in RS as BJP MP says tribal candidate in Telangana committed suicide under pressure
item.description: BJP MP T. Lakshman (Uttar Pradesh) raised a serious concern, claiming “that a tribal candidate from Telangana had died by suicide after being allegedly compelled by a state minister to withdraw his nomination from the polls.”
